:::{#prp-cind-own-covariate}
#### Conditional independence when each $Y_i$ depends only on its own $X_i$

Let $\vX = (\Xin)$ be a discrete random vector,
and let $\dsn{Y}$ be [conditionally independent](#def-cind) given $\vX$.
Suppose also that each $Y_i$ depends on $\vX$ only through $X_i$:
for every $\vx = (\dsn{x})$ with $\Pr(\vX = \vx) > 0$
and every set of real numbers $A_i$,

$$\Pr(Y_i \in A_i \mid \vX = \vx) = \Pr(Y_i \in A_i \mid X_i = x_i)$$

Then, for every such $\vx$ and all sets of real numbers $\dsn{A}$:

$$\Pr(Y_1 \in A_1, \ldots, Y_n \in A_n \mid \vX = \vx) = \prodin{\Pr(Y_i \in A_i \mid X_i = x_i)}$$

:::

::: proof

Each conditional probability given $X_i = x_i$ is defined,
because $\Pr(X_i = x_i) \ge \Pr(\vX = \vx) > 0$. So:

$$
\ba
\Pr(Y_1 \in A_1, \ldots, Y_n \in A_n \mid \vX = \vx)
&= \prodin{\Pr(Y_i \in A_i \mid \vX = \vx)}
&& \text{(conditional independence given } \vX \text{)} \\
&= \prodin{\Pr(Y_i \in A_i \mid X_i = x_i)}
&& \text{(each } Y_i \text{ depends on } \vX \text{ only through } X_i \text{)}
\ea
$$

:::
